Nvidia's gross profit rose about 56.8% from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026.

- Fiscal 2026 gross profit was $153,463 million. That is revenue of $215,938 million less cost of revenue of $62,475 million.
- Fiscal 2025 gross profit was $97,858 million. That is revenue of $130,497 million less cost of revenue of $32,639 million.
- The change is (153,463 − 97,858) / 97,858, which is about +56.8%.

The figures come from Nvidia's fiscal 2026 earnings release and 10-K.
